messages:
Maya R.: Quick sync — planning to deploy inference-service v1.5.0 at 11:00 PST today. Can everyone confirm rollback readiness and smoke checks? No DB migrations. Canary to 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-inference-service
Chris L.: I can own the rollout. I'll be on the call at 10:50. Rollback criteria: increased 95th latency > 200ms over baseline OR error rate > 1% for 5m.
Devin: I reviewed the runbook. Rollback commands look fine. Key check: KV cache warmup step needs verification during canary.
Olga K.: I'll run perf dashboards and watch the token throughput. Can we add an automated alert for spike in token rejection?
Samir: +1 on the latency criteria. I'll prepare hotfix image tag v1.5.0-rollback-ready that we can roll to if needed.
deploy-bot: CI passed: inference-service:v1.5.0 built successfully (sha: ab12cd). Canary image pushed to registry.
Maya R.: Good. Quick smoke checklist I want in the runbook for this deploy: 1) Liveness + readiness ok 2) 5% canary health for 10m 3) KV cache hitrate > 60% after warmup 4) 95th token latency within threshold 5) no function-call regressions on sample prompt set
Chris L.: Adding commands for quick checks:
```
# liveness
curl -fS http://inference-canary.internal/_health || echo "unhealthy"
# quick latency sample
curl -s -X POST http://inference-canary.internal/gen -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":16}' | jq -r '.time_ms'
```
Devin: Important rollback step if deploy is bad:
```
# rollback to previous deployment
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=3 -n prod
# or force image
kubectl set image deployment/inference-service inference-service=registry/redwood/inference:v1.4.3 -n prod
```
Olga K.: Also keep the feature flag toggles handy — we can flip off new-routing then route all traffic to stable. Flag name: features.inference_v1_5_routing
Samir: Canary plan: 5% (10m) -> monitor -> 25% (15m) -> monitor -> 100%. If any step hits rollback criteria we abort and run rollback steps. I put a checklist in the runbook section "abort & revert".
Maya R.: Who's on-call for rollback execution if we hit the threshold during the 25% step?
Chris L.: I'll execute rollback if Samir confirms degraded metrics. I'll post timeline and ETA when I start.
Samir: I'll be actively watching. If I see steady regression for 3 consecutive minutes I'll call for rollback.
Olga K.: I'll prepare the dashboard share and short links. Also pre-create an alert view: latency, err_rate, kv_hitrate, cpu/gpu_util.
deploy-bot: Monitoring hooks created: canary-latency-alert, canary-error-rate-alert. Alerts configured to page on-call after 3m sustained breach.
Devin: Two more notes: 1) No DB migration so rollback is safe, 2) Make sure hotfix image is approved by gatekeeper policy (I pre-approved).
Maya R.: Excellent. Final go/no-go timeline: 10:50 brief, 11:00 start canary. If no objections by 10:45 I will mark deploy as GO.
Chris L.: :thumbsup: GO from infra.
Olga K.: GO from observability.
Devin: GO — I validated runbook steps.
Samir: GO — will monitor and call rollback if needed.
Maya R.: Thanks all. I'll post a short post-deploy checklist after the 100% step. Keep this thread for any live updates during rollout.
Chris L.: Noted. If anyone needs to trigger rollback remotely: ping me and tag @Chris L. in the thread.
Samir: I'll also be ready to execute the kubectl commands if Chris is tied up.
Maya R.: Closing planning phase — see you on the call at 10:50.
